notes: Account overview: mid-market SaaS (product analytics) building in-app assistant + search for product discovery. PLG with enterprise customers; must support SSO and per-customer data residency.
Initial engagement: Signed up for Hosted API trial (self-serve) on 2026-01-20. Quickstart integration completed by mobile/web teams within 48h (SDK + server-side).
Early metrics from Hosted trial (samples): avg QPS during business hours: 4.2; 95th percentile bursts up to 11 QPS; sustained off-peak 0.6 QPS. Peak concurrency observed 9 concurrent requests.

Token profile (sampled 10k requests): median prompt tokens = 78; median completion tokens = 210; long-tail: ~8% requests > 1.5k tokens (deep context for multi-doc summarization). Avg token ratio completion:prompt ~2.7x.

Latency targets: product team needs p95 <= 300ms for chat flows; p99 < 800ms acceptable for long-runner summarization. Current Hosted results: p95 ~260ms for default model (region us-west), p99 ~1.1s when long-token completions hit.

Cost sensitivity: Director of Prod (quote): 'We need predictable $/MAU. Anything that spikes unit costs on long completions will be hard to justify.' They asked for cost model tied to token mix and batching tradeoffs.
Use-case breakdown: 60% chat support (short-ish prompts), 25% semantic search (embeddings, batched), 15% reranking and long-form summarization (high token outputs).
Team composition: CTO (Eric Molina), Head of ML (Priya Shah), Infra lead (Carlos Vega) - will own Dedicated evaluation and KMS integration. AE = Aisha, SE = Tom, CSM = Elena.
Security/compliance: SOC2 is required; legal flagged data residency for EU enterprise customers. They want KMS control for any Dedicated deployment and audit logging surfaced to their SIEM.

POC ask for Dedicated: 1) capacity planning worksheet showing nodes needed for target QPS/concurrency and token mix, 2) pricing comparison (hosted vs. dedicated committed), 3) security integration diagram for VPC + KMS.
Preliminary Dedicated sizing notes (SE calc, Feb 18 workshop):
- Target steady-state: 5 QPS average, peak sustained bursts to 12 QPS for 30-90s windows.
- Concurrency target: support 12 concurrent chat streams with KV caching; expected average token generation per request 200-300 tokens.
- Token throughput estimate (monthly): 45M prompt tokens + 120M completion tokens -> ~165M tokens/mo.

- Suggested Dedicated profile: 2 x GPU nodes (each node estimated to handle ~8-10 steady QPS for short-completion workloads) + autoscale headroom for bursts; consider 1 additional node for embeddings throughput if embedding batch jobs run off-peak.
- P99 risk: long completions drive GPU memory and latency; recommend using prefix caching + quantized variant for reranking/summarization models to lower cost on Dedicated.
Integration notes: infra team wants explicit egress/KMS flow diagram; cannot allow model logs to leave customer VPC without encryption and redaction. SE to supply architecture sketch (action).

Pricing convo: they requested committed monthly price for Dedicated (baseline 2-node + burst to 3) with 12-month term. Finance to prepare TCV vs hosted baseline; customer prefers blended egress + compute SKU clarity.
